description: This file defines the SugarCronJobs class, which manages scheduled task execution within the SuiteCRM environment. It handles job queuing, execution control, scheduling cycles, and failure handling for CRON-based background tasks.

classes.name: SugarCronJobs
classes.description: A class responsible for orchestrating scheduled job execution, including job queue management, scheduling, runtime controls, and failure handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarCronJobs instance, setting configuration options and creating the job queue.

methods.name: markLastRun
methods.description: Records the last run timestamp in a lock file to manage cron run intervals.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Ensures cron jobs don't run more frequently than configured, based on the min_interval setting.

methods.name: jobFailed
methods.description: Handles logging and reporting when a scheduled job fails.

methods.name: unexpectedExit
methods.description: Shutdown handler to clean up if a job fails or the script terminates unexpectedly.

methods.name: getMyId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for this cron execution instance.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Runs an individual scheduled job and handles failure if it occurs.

methods.name: runCycle
methods.description: Performs a full cron cycle: cleanup, scheduling, job execution, respecting runtime limits and configuration.

methods.name: runOk
methods.description: Returns whether the last cron cycle completed successfully.
